title: SYNTHETIC scalar projection; NOT the ProphetX contract
description: A test-only scalar claim sharing the documented strict USD threshold and a conditional clock envelope. It cannot express per-trade-date source fallback, required data eligibility, conditional collateral return, or Rule 5.2. The end is a half-open explanatory envelope, not a transcription of the reported-trade-date rule. Monday-Friday cutoff and latest settlement instants are assumptions for this witness only.

reference.metricDefinition: An assumed already computed monthly scalar. This test does not verify Gemini report rows, reported trade dates, completeness, settlement multipliers, category aggregation, or the real contract.

normalizedFields: No field establishes a verified real ClaimSpec
provenance.interpretation: Only a scalar projection. Fixed instants assume the filing's expected ET envelope and two following weekdays, without establishing a governing holiday calendar. SettlementAt is an assumed test time. Source precedence is whole-period and deliberately cannot implement the documented per-trade-date fallback. Missing-data, review and void rules remain absent; no result from this witness is a real contract determination.
